cards.name: General Staff
cards.vibe: Turn scattered commands into a single campaign.
cards.effect: Armies fight {fx.fight|up} harder. Battle casualties are {fx.bleed|down} lower.
cards.steer: Raises estimated victory odds and reduces the forecast cost of fighting with the army you already have.

cards.name: Rifled Artillery
cards.vibe: Make the guns count before the first advance.
cards.effect: Armies fight {fx.fight|up} harder.
cards.steer: Improves victory odds in the invasion forecast and strength in actual battles.

cards.name: Army Medical Corps
cards.vibe: Keep experienced formations in the field.
cards.effect: Armies fight {fx.fight|up} harder. Battle casualties are {fx.bleed|down} lower.
cards.steer: Makes campaigns less costly while improving the army’s chances of winning.

cards.name: Campaign Administration
cards.vibe: Make a victory pay before the next campaign.
cards.effect: Armies fight {fx.fight|up} harder. Conquests integrate {fx.integrate|up} faster.
cards.steer: Combines better combat odds with an earlier economic return from conquest.

cards.name: Border War College
cards.vibe: Know the rival across the frontier.
cards.effect: Armies fight {targetFight|up} harder against {nation} only. Battle casualties are {fx.bleed|down} lower in all wars.
cards.steer: Improves the forecast against {nation}. Lower casualties also make other campaigns less costly.

cards.name: National Defence
cards.vibe: Make every border province worth defending.
cards.effect: Armies fight {fx.homeFight|up} harder in wars over your nation’s own land. Fortresses cost {fx.fortCost|down} less.
cards.steer: Changes the estimated balance in wars over national land and makes threatened borders cheaper to fortify.

cards.name: Frontier Engineers
cards.vibe: Let roads, earthworks and bridges serve the army.
cards.effect: Fortresses cost {fx.fortCost|down} less. Armies fight {fx.fight|up} harder.
cards.steer: Makes border fortification much cheaper and also improves military odds.

cards.name: Staff Colleges
cards.vibe: Plan the campaign and the peace that follows.
cards.effect: Ministers plan {fx.horizon|word} more years ahead. Armies fight {fx.fight|up} harder.
cards.steer: Counts more years of a conquest’s returns while improving victory odds. Long-term civilian investments also become more attractive.

cards.name: Expeditionary Service
cards.vibe: Prepare to hold what the army wins abroad.
cards.effect: Armies fight {fx.fight|up} harder. Other peoples’ provinces integrate {fx.integrateOther|up} faster.
cards.steer: Improves combat odds and makes foreign conquests repay their costs sooner.

cards.name: War Ministry
cards.vibe: Give campaigns a permanent staff and a lasting budget.
cards.effect: Armies fight {fx.fight|up} harder and upkeep is {fx.upkeep|down} lower. Conquests integrate {fx.integrate|up} faster. Ministers plan {fx.horizon|word} more years ahead.
cards.steer: Makes campaigns cheaper to maintain, improves victory odds and counts more of a conquest’s future returns. Also changes civilian investment forecasts.

cards.name: Machine Tools
cards.vibe: Equip the workshops that build the future.
cards.effect: Factories cost {fx.factoryCost|down} less.
cards.steer: Directly lowers factory prices and brings more industrial investments within reach.

cards.name: Steam Shipping
cards.vibe: Bring the ports into the age of steam.
cards.effect: Sea trade earns {fx.trade|up} more.
cards.steer: Makes coastal earnings more valuable. Ministers also count more lost trade when weighing a war.

cards.name: Industrial Credit
cards.vibe: Give new industry time to repay its debts.
cards.effect: Factories cost {fx.factoryCost|down} less. Ministers plan {fx.horizon|word} more years ahead.
cards.steer: Lowers the initial investment and counts more years of factory returns.

cards.name: Railway Procurement
cards.vibe: Buy iron and engineering on a national scale.
cards.effect: Factories cost {fx.factoryCost|down} less. Fortresses cost {fx.fortCost|down} less.
cards.steer: Makes both industrial construction and border defence more affordable.

cards.name: Merchant Banks
cards.vibe: Connect the customs house to the counting house.
cards.effect: Sea trade earns {fx.trade|up} more. Taxes earn {fx.taxes|up} more.
cards.steer: Changes the value of commerce and taxable provinces, while increasing funds for investment.

cards.name: Industrial Standards
cards.vibe: Make the machinery fit from one workshop to the next.
cards.effect: All earnings rise by {fx.earns|up}. Factories cost {fx.factoryCost|down} less.
cards.steer: Raises the forecast return on factories as well as reducing their price.

cards.name: Export Houses
cards.vibe: Connect newly acquired ports to established markets.
cards.effect: Sea trade earns {fx.trade|up} more. Conquests integrate {fx.integrate|up} faster.
cards.steer: Strengthens peaceful trade and brings the rewards of new territory forward. Ministers weigh both effects.

cards.name: Land Survey
cards.vibe: Know what the land can contribute.
cards.effect: Taxes earn {fx.taxes|up} more.
cards.steer: Increases the forecast value of taxable provinces, both at home and across the border.

cards.name: Domestic Markets
cards.vibe: Connect familiar towns to a national market.
cards.effect: Accepted peoples’ taxes rise by {fx.ownTaxes|up}. Factories cost {fx.factoryCost|down} less.
cards.steer: Makes investment cheaper and increases the tax value of provinces whose people your nation accepts.

cards.name: Precision Engineering
cards.vibe: The same workshops make engines and armaments.
cards.effect: Factories cost {fx.factoryCost|down} less. Armies fight {fx.fight|up} harder.
cards.steer: Improves industrial investment and military forecasts together.

cards.name: Professional Civil Service
cards.vibe: Put the nation’s resources to work.
cards.effect: All earnings rise by {fx.earns|up}.
cards.steer: Raises the returns ministers expect from economic improvements and taxable territory.

cards.name: Parliamentary Procedure
cards.vibe: Make reform possible before the streets demand it.
cards.effect: Reforms cost {fx.reformCost|down} less.
cards.steer: Directly lowers the price ministers compare against the expected benefits of reform.

cards.name: Public Institutions
cards.vibe: Give public reform the means to make a difference.
cards.effect: Reforms remove {fx.reformCalm|up} more unrest.
cards.steer: Makes reform more valuable where unrest is hurting production or threatening an uprising.

cards.name: Regional Administration
cards.vibe: Turn new provinces into lasting parts of the nation.
cards.effect: Conquests integrate {fx.integrate|up} faster.
cards.steer: Brings the economic rewards of a possible conquest much closer in the invasion forecast.

cards.name: Provincial Rights
cards.vibe: Let a wider realm find common ground.
cards.effect: Other peoples’ provinces integrate {fx.integrateOther|up} faster. Reforms remove {fx.reformCalm|up} more unrest.
cards.steer: Makes foreign conquests pay sooner and gives ministers a stronger response to unrest.

cards.name: Public Accounts
cards.vibe: Make taxation and public spending easier to administer.
cards.effect: Taxes earn {fx.taxes|up} more. Reforms cost {fx.reformCost|down} less.
cards.steer: Increases the value recovered by calming unrest while lowering the cost of reform.

cards.name: National Schools
cards.vibe: Build institutions that outlive the present reign.
cards.effect: Ministers plan {fx.horizon|word} more years ahead. Accepted peoples’ taxes rise by {fx.ownTaxes|up}.
cards.steer: Makes long-term investments and provinces with accepted peoples more valuable in the forecast.

cards.name: Technical Universities
cards.vibe: Put knowledge to work over a longer future.
cards.effect: Ministers plan {fx.horizon|word} more years ahead. All earnings rise by {fx.earns|up}.
cards.steer: Raises and extends the forecast returns from investment and territorial gains.

cards.name: Civic Mediation
cards.vibe: Make useful reform easier to agree and deliver.
cards.effect: Reforms cost {fx.reformCost|down} less and remove {fx.reformCalm|up} more unrest.
cards.steer: Changes both sides of the reform calculation: a smaller expense for a larger benefit.

cards.name: Consular Service
cards.vibe: Build lasting institutions around the ports.
cards.effect: Conquests integrate {fx.integrate|up} faster. Sea trade earns {fx.trade|up} more.
cards.steer: Balances earlier returns from new territory against the increased value of peaceful commerce.
